lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Server Graveyard, 2148. Racks the length of a street, tipped into the mud. Rain has been getting into them for a century.

lines.speaker: dax
lines.text: People used to come out here and pray at these. Actually kneel. My grandmother did.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Somewhere under the stacks, something is singing. Four seconds of it, then four seconds again, then four seconds again.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That is a liturgy. Second office, Kell use. It has the words wrong in the same place every time.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the end of the racks there is a cradle, and a shape strapped into it with Board welds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the end of the racks there is an empty cradle with its restraints cut.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: At the end of the racks there is a cradle with something broken in it.
